name: Entity Import
project_description: The entity importer module provides a user interface for site administrators to import content entities. It ships a CSV source out of the box; because sources are migrate source plugins, other file/data formats can be added. It is built on top of the core Migrate API: each configured importer becomes a derived migration, so importers support migration dependencies, field mappings, and data processing/transformation (migrate lookups, entity lookup, string replacement, explode, extract, callbacks, etc.) that you would otherwise hand-write in a migration YAML — all through a point-and-click admin interface. Uploaded files are parsed, imported into the chosen entity type/bundle, can be re-run to update existing entities, rolled back, and inspected via per-importer logs.
